workflow_plan.goal: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Join population attributes to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Combine the tract geometries with their corresponding total population records.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an attribute join between input_1 and input_2 using GEOID as the vector and table join key. Preserve one joined record per census tract and retain the tract geometry and total_pop field.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate population and land area by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the requested tract-level totals for population and polygon land area.
workflow_steps.instructions: Using joined_tracts, retain census tract identity and calculate total population from total_pop and polygon land area from each tract geometry. Report land area in square metres using the input projected metric CRS, with one output record per census tract.
